issues.detail: Combined isolated yields and additional single-isomer purification yields are distinct. Do not multiply a mixture ratio to invent isolated yields.
issues.subject: E05/E10/E12/E14/E15/E16/E17

issues.detail: Two minor alcohol isomers and minor dimer 22 components are not structurally assigned in source. Their presence is retained as unresolved mixture components, not fabricated structures.
Source 7 input ratios vary between 44:43:8:5, 51:49 and 54:43:3 across preparations; source 1 is 86:14 in SI and 83:17 in main Scheme 5. Preserve experiment-specific values.
SI reports 430 g from a 2 mmol iodination; inconsistent mass unit retained as a source issue, not normalized.

issues.detail: 17 is the synthesized originally misassigned K structure. Revised natural K is 3; these identities must not be merged.

issues.detail: Main Scheme 5B reports 70:30 NMR equilibrium of dimer/monomer, not isolated synthetic yields. Stored as control metadata, excluded from target paths.
